_comment: Known failures for the PyTorch c10d_nccl2 suite (SUITES in test_pytorch_c10d.py). Keys are "Class.test" as reported in the JUnit XML. Same rules as known_failures.json: an entry is excluded from the verdict so a new failure stays visible, it is not a statement that the test is expected to fail forever, and each entry should name a ticket or cause. Remove an entry once its cause is resolved; the harness logs entries that now pass.
